source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1990 official canvass
source_notes: 1990 regular Arizona gubernatorial election. County and statewide cells transcribed from page 2 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State (1990-11-26); every candidate's county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL, and the statewide totals also match Wikipedia's results table (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1990_Arizona_gubernatorial_election). Every cell was first transcribed from RightDataUSA's county page and then checked against the canvass, which corrected one cell (Terry Goddard, Gila: 7,693 to 7,893) and closed the 200-vote gap on that page. Named write-ins are itemized as the canvass prints them. The canvass notes a runoff election was to be held under Arizona Constitution Art. V, Sec. 1 because no candidate won a majority; the runoff is not part of this general-election contest. Election-wide registration, ballots cast and turnout are the official figures from page 1 of the canvass. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer and is retained with its SHA-256.
